input rate: Money/cwt = $25/cwt

charge "Linehaul" (quantity: weight, rate: rate)
charge "Fuel" as FSC = $10
minimum $90

test "a 1,240 lb load bills at the next hundred pounds" {
  given shipment.weight = 1_240 lb
  expect charge("Linehaul") == $325
  expect charge(FSC) == $10
  expect total == $335
}

name: tests see the sample record
tests:
tariff "s"
charge "x" = $1
test "sample" {
  expect shipment.proNumber == "SAMPLE"
  expect shipment.stops.len == 2
  expect shipment.pickup?.kind == Pickup
  expect shipment.delivery?.sequence == 2
  expect rating.date == @2026-01-05T12:00Z
  expect rating.mode == Sell
  expect customer.name == "Sample customer"
  expect shipment.serviceType.code == "STD"
  expect shipment.distance == 0 mi
  expect fuel.price == none
  expect lane.origin.zip == ""
  expect shipment.commodities.isEmpty
}

name: constructors fill sequences, dwell, pickup and delivery
tests:
tariff "s"
charge "x" = $1
test "stops" {
  given shipment.stops = [pickup(arrival: @2026-01-05T08:00Z, departure: @2026-01-05T11:30Z), delivery(), splitDelivery(sequence: 9)]
  expect shipment.stops[0]?.sequence == 1
  expect shipment.stops[1]?.sequence == 2
  expect shipment.stops[2]?.sequence == 9
  expect shipment.stops[0]?.dwell == 3.5 h
  expect shipment.stops[1]?.dwell == none
  expect shipment.pickup?.sequence == 1
  expect shipment.delivery?.kind == SplitDelivery
}

name: a given pickup is kept
tests:
tariff "s"
charge "x" = $1
test "pickup" {
  given shipment.pickup = pickup(sequence: 7)
  given shipment.stops = [delivery()]
  expect shipment.pickup?.sequence == 7
  expect shipment.delivery?.sequence == 1
}

name: a given dwell is kept
commodities are built from defaults
tests:
tariff "s"
charge "x" = $1
test "commodities" {
  given shipment.commodities = [commodity(weight: 500 lb, freightClass: Class85), commodity(name: "b")]
  expect shipment.commodities.sum(c => c.weight) == 500 lb
  expect shipment.commodities[1]?.name == "b"
  expect shipment.commodities[0]?.freightClass == Class85
}

name: nested givens
tests:

test "nested" {
  given lane.origin.zip3 = "752"
